about: The tables' fluidity budgets (fluid-07; tables programme T5c, T6, T7, TB7): surfaces.mjs --only tables on a production build against the fake server side, with the tables programme's synthetic 13-field table (perf-harness/lib.mjs, moved into workspace.mjs) at 10,000 and 100,000 rows, on a computer at 1x and a phone at 4x (FLUIDITY-LEAD, 20 Oct 2026).

measured is the median of 5 runs on beta 482460c3d. Targets and their sources are in each budget; the tables programme's proposed budgets (perf-data/tables-budgets.proposed.json) agree with them where they overlap.
Renders are enforced; times are printed against their max until they hold on a quiet P-core slot. Never raise a max to make a run pass.

table10kOpenMs.source: The 10,000-row table in a new tab until its first rows (the 500-row bundle). Beta 482460c3d on fixtures, 20 Oct 2026, P-cores, median of 5: 1047 at 1x on a computer (load 12 to 25), 3848 at 4x on a phone (load 22 to 44). Times above load 16 are inflated: provisional until a quiet rerun. Target: A new tab, nothing in memory: 1.0 s on a computer, 2.5 s on the 4x phone (chat programme Wave C, perf-mobile.md; Nielsen's 1 s limit for the flow of thought)

table10kScrollFrameP95Ms.source: Frame time p95 scrolling the 10,000-row grid down, back and across, every row held. Beta 482460c3d on fixtures, 20 Oct 2026, P-cores, median of 5: 50 at 1x on a computer (load 12 to 25), 100 at 4x on a phone (load 22 to 44). Times above load 16 are inflated: provisional until a quiet rerun. Target: Frame time p95 while it scrolls or drags: one 60 Hz refresh (16.7 ms) on a computer, two (33.4 ms) on the 4x phone (the brief; 60 fps, never under 30)

Beta 482460c3d on fixtures, 20 Oct 2026, P-cores, median of 5: 66.7 at 1x on a computer (load 12 to 25), 150 at 4x on a phone (load 22 to 44). table10kScrollRenders.source: Renders while the 10,000-row grid scrolls (about 43 a row entering). Beta 482460c3d on fixtures, 20 Oct 2026, P-cores, median of 5: 10506 at 1x on a computer (load 12 to 25). at 4x: 6647, not yet a budget (the rerun counted 0). Target: render only what changed (the fluidity method: rows memoised on id-only props, a window of the rows on screen)

table10kCommitLongMs.source: Long tasks after a Notes cell is committed: the whole bundle is fetched and parsed again. Beta 482460c3d on fixtures, 20 Oct 2026, P-cores, median of 5: 83 at 1x on a computer (load 12 to 25). Times above load 16 are inflated: provisional until a quiet rerun. Target: Long tasks during the step: none over 50 ms on a computer (RAIL), at most 100 ms of them on the 4x phone

table100kCommitLongMs.source: Long tasks after a cell is committed at 100,000 rows. Beta 482460c3d on fixtures, 20 Oct 2026, P-cores, median of 5: 0 at 1x on a computer (load 12 to 25). Times above load 16 are inflated: provisional until a quiet rerun. Target: Long tasks during the step: none over 50 ms on a computer (RAIL), at most 100 ms of them on the 4x phone

table10kFormulaMs.source: Amount changed until Total (a formula) shows the new value: it waits for the full bundle to come back. Beta 482460c3d on fixtures, 20 Oct 2026, P-cores, median of 5: 1084 at 1x on a computer (load 28 to 39). Times above load 16 are inflated: provisional until a quiet rerun. Target: An edit committed and shown (optimistic, then saved): 100 ms on a computer, 300 ms on the 4x phone (the brief: optimistic updates for every edit)

table100kLoadAllMs.source: Every row read in ('Load all'): 100 pages of 1,000 at 100,000 rows. Report only: Row Query's windows (T5c) remove it. Beta 482460c3d on fixtures, 20 Oct 2026, P-cores, median of 5: 13122 at 1x on a computer (load 12 to 25), 17372 at 4x on a phone (load 22 to 44). Times above load 16 are inflated: provisional until a quiet rerun.
